points.description: States one advantage of TiC/TiN tool coating from the model answer: excellent wear resistance, thermal stability, low coefficient of friction, improves thermal transfer, or increases tool life. Equivalent wording is accepted.

States a second, different advantage from the same list (for example, if P1 was wear resistance, any of thermal stability, low coefficient of friction, improved thermal transfer, or increased tool life). Restating the same advantage in different words does not earn this mark.
